title: Oracle CX Technical Consultant - Redwood UI Specialist
Team Lead - Dot Net + Angular
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Evince Development Pvt. Ltd. (EvinceDev) is a CMMI 3\-Level leading IT service company that delivers innovative solutions to clients worldwide. With a commitment to excellence and a dynamic team of professionals, we aim to exceed client expectations and drive success through cutting\-edge technology.
 



  





**Website link:** 
 https://evincedev.com/
 



  





**Job Description** 




  




* Develop highly interactive, responsive, and performant user interfaces using Angular (v16\+) with advanced features like Signals, Standalone Components, and Functional Guards Architect.
* implement scalable server\-side solutions using .NET 6\+/8, following microservices architecture, clean architecture (Onion/Hexagonal), and Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) principles.
* Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and SEO using server\-side rendering (SSR) with Angular Universal and advanced hydration techniques.
* Design and consume RESTful \& GraphQL APIs and implement gRPC for high\-performance inter\-service communication, including support for gRPC streaming and interceptors.
* Drive advanced state management using NgRx or Standalone Services in Angular applications.
* Implement real\-time features using SignalR/Socket.IO in .NET for live updates and system notifications.
* Follow secure coding practices based on OWASP standards, including JWT authentication, OAuth 2\.0, and RBAC.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests using Jasmine/Karma (Angular) and xUnit/NUnit (.NET), leveraging mocking tools like Moq or NSubstitute.
* Build responsive and adaptive UIs using TailwindCSS, FlexLayout, Angular Material, or Bootstrap. Use GIT for version control and maintain a clean commit history with appropriate branching strategies.
* Participate in and help guide Agile practices sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives.
* Analyze application performance and resolve bottlenecks through profiling and optimization strategies.
* Document APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI and perform API\-level testing.
* Participate in peer code reviews and mentor junior team members to maintain code quality and standards.
* Architect and develop modular applications using Angular Micro Frontends with Webpack Module Federation.
* Expert in TypeScript, with deep knowledge of interfaces, generics, and object\-oriented principles.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous programming using async/await, Promises, and Observables.
* In\-depth experience with Angular (v16\+), including Signals, Standalone Components, lazy\-loaded modules, and Angular Elements for building Web Components.
* Proficient in RxJS, including advanced operators, Subjects, and custom Observables. Strong experience in developing Web Apps and REST APIs using ASP.NET Core and C\#.
* Hands\-on expertise with Entity Framework Core, LINQ, and code\-first data migrations.
* Solid understanding of middleware pipelines, dependency injection, and attribute\-based routing.
* Experience with authentication/authorization using JWT, OAuth, and ASP.NET Identity. Strong command of CQRS with MediatR, including pipeline behaviors (logging, validation, caching).



  





**How to Apply:** 




  





 Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume on career@evincedev.com
 



  





 EvinceDev is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.
 



  





 We are looking forward to meeting our next Spartan!

title: Senior Engineer – Digital Solutions and AI Integration
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Web Application \& Software Engineering**
* Architect \& Build Applications: Design, develop, and deploy responsive, high\-performance web applications using modern full\-stack frameworks (e.g., MERN, MEAN, LAMP, or Java/Spring Boot).
* API Development \& Integration: Design and implement RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and microservices to enable seamless communication between front\-end interfaces, back\-end systems, and third\-party tools.
* Database Management: Structure, optimize, and maintain relational (SQL), non\-relational (NoSQL) and unstructured databases like SharePoint Lists, Excels, etc. to support high\-throughput, enterprise\-scale applications.


**Data Engineering \& Business Intelligence**
* ETL \& Data Pipeline Design: Conceptualize, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT flows to consolidate data from disparate transactional systems, cloud databases, and third\-party APIs.
* Dashboard \& Analytics Engineering: Translate business requirements into intuitive, interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for executive decision\-making.
* Data Modeling \& Governance: Ensure data accuracy, consistency, security, and integrity across relational data models, transactional schemas, and enterprise data marts.


**Enterprise Process Automation**
* Workflow Automation: Identify manual operational workflows and design automated end\-to\-end process flows using Microsoft Power Automate and custom scripts.
* System Integration: Connect enterprise applications (ERP, CRM, legacy databases, web portals) using cloud flows, desktop flows (RPA), and webhooks.


**AI \& Emerging Technology Integration**
* Generative \& Agentic AI Solutions: Architect and implement solutions incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and autonomous Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex).
* AI Tooling \& Prompt Engineering: Build AI\-driven feature enhancements into enterprise web portals and workflow engines to enhance productivity and user experience.


**Cloud \& DevOps Operations**
* Cloud Architecture: Deploy, manage, and scale applications and data infrastructure across major public cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform).
* CI/CD \& Code Hygiene: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines, maintain repository hygiene, conduct code reviews, and enforce security and data compliance standards.


**Qualifications**
**Key Skill Requirements**
**Hands\-on Experience**
* 4 to 8 years of core hands\-on experience in full\-stack software development, data engineering, and automation solutions.


**Software \& Web Development Stack**
* Proficiency in at least one primary full\-stack development technology suite:
+ MERN / MEAN: React.js, Angular, Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js
+ Java Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Spring MVC
+ LAMP / Web: PHP, Apache/Nginx, Linux, MySQL, JavaScript/HTML5/CSS3


**Data Engineering \& Analytics**
* Experience in designing ETL/ELT processes using tools like Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Apache Airflow, or SSIS.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling, Security Management, Custom Visuals).
* Proficiency with both SQL (PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, Cassandra) databases.


**Process Automation**
* Proven track record in building enterprise automation workflows using Microsoft Power Automate (Cloud \& Desktop flows).


**Cloud Platforms**
* Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including serverless computing, object storage, managed database services, and IAM policies.


**Teamwork, Communication \& Execution**
* Collaboration \& Team Player: Demonstrated capability to work effectively within multi\-disciplinary \& multi\-location teams, engaging collaboratively with team members, product managers, vendor partners, UX designers, and business stakeholders.
* Interpersonal \& Communication Skills: Adept at verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal skills to translate technical concepts for non\-technical leadership and clearly express solution requirements, designs, concepts, etc.
* Action\-Oriented \& Proactive: Highly self\-motivated, action\-oriented, and proactive in taking ownership, identifying potential roadblocks early, and proposing practical digital solutions.


**Preferred Experience**
* Generative \& Agentic AI:
+ Understanding of LLM/SLM fine\-tuning, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, ChromaDB, Qdrant).
+ Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and function\-calling protocols.

* DevOps \& Containerization: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps for automated building and deployment.
* Scripting Languages: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript for data processing and AI script integration.
* Agile Delivery: Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with cross\-functional business, data, and digital product teams.
* Problem\-Solving \& Communication: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical architectures and articulate tech solutions to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualification**
* Primary Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a closely related discipline (B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech / MCA / M.Sc).
* Certifications (Desirable):
+ Cloud: Azure Developer/Data Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Developer/Solutions Architect, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
+ Analytics \& Automation: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\) or Power Platform App Maker / Developer (PL\-100/PL\-400\).

title: Frontend Engineer Intern
description:
**Location: India (Remote)** 
  
 



**Shift: Evening Shift \| 1:30 PM – 10:30 PM IST** 
  
 



**Employment Type: Internship** 




**About the Role** 




  





 Reveation Labs is looking for a motivated UI Engineer Intern to join our frontend development team. The intern will work on building responsive, user\-friendly web interfaces and contribute to real\-world projects using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, WordPress, WooCommerce, and PHP.
 



  





 You will collaborate with UI/UX designers, frontend engineers, and backend developers to convert designs into high\-quality, responsive, and performant web experiences.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Develop responsive and user\-friendly web interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as React, Vue, or Angular.
* Convert UI/UX designs, wireframes, and prototypes into pixel\-accurate web interfaces.
* Develop, customize, and maintain websites using WordPress.
* Build and customize WooCommerce websites, themes, templates, and storefront components.
* Use PHP for basic WordPress and WooCommerce customization and development.
* Create reusable UI components and contribute to UI component libraries and design systems.
* Implement responsive layouts and ensure cross\-browser and cross\-device compatibility.
* Optimize websites for performance, page speed, scalability, and accessibility.
* Debug and troubleshoot frontend, UI, WordPress, and browser\-related issues.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Use Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
* Participate in code reviews, team meetings, and development discussions.
* Stay updated with modern frontend development, UI engineering, WordPress, and web technologies.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong foundation in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
* Basic knowledge of responsive web design and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Familiarity with React, Vue.js, or Angular.
* Hands\-on knowledge of WordPress.
* Basic experience with WooCommerce.
* Basic knowledge of PHP and its use in WordPress/WooCommerce.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub and version control.
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Strong attention to detail and understanding of UI consistency.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience converting Figma/Adobe XD designs to HTML/CSS.
* Knowledge of Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, or other CSS frameworks.
* Understanding of REST APIs and frontend\-backend integration.
* Experience with WordPress theme/plugin customization.
* Experience with WooCommerce customization.
* Basic understanding of SEO, web accessibility, and web performance optimization.
* Personal projects, portfolio, or GitHub profile demonstrating frontend/UI development skills.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Hands\-on experience with real\-world UI and frontend development projects.
* Opportunity to work with React, WordPress, WooCommerce, PHP, and modern web technologies.
* Mentorship and opportunities for technical and professional growth.
* Exposure to professional development workflows and client projects.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.
* Flexible remote working environment.
* Opportunity to work with a dynamic and global technology team.



  





**Company Information** 
 : Reveation Labs is a USA\-based, AI\-enabled digital solutions partner helping mid\-market B2B organizations accelerate digital transformation and business growth. With deep expertise in B2B eCommerce, Customer Portals, Product Data \& Integration Management, AI Enabled Digital Transformation, Cloud Computing, and Enterprise Systems Integration, Reveation Labs delivers scalable, outcome\-driven solutions that streamline operations and enhance customer experiences. Backed by industry experts with extensive experience in enterprise technology and digital innovation, the company combines strategic consulting, modern engineering practices, and emerging technologies such as Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation to help organizations achieve measurable business results and long\-term success.
 



  





**Why Reveation Labs?** 
 We Truly Believe that where your work matters \& as a software company, we know a thing or two about what makes employees happy. When you Join Reveation Labs, you do more than simply switch companies to advance your career. You become part of the Reveation Labs Family, a group of talented people who drive innovation, embrace change \& celebrate the global community which is Reveation Labs.
